title: Shaolin Wooden Men
description: A fighter vows not to speak until he finds the masked man who killed his father.

title: A Walk in the Woods
description: Travel writer Bill Bryson (Robert Redford) takes a long-lost old friend (Nick Nolte) for a hike along the Appalachian Trail, which stretches more than 2,000 miles from Georgia to Maine.

title: Take Me Home Tonight
description: A directionless college grad (Topher Grace) sees a chance to win the girl of his dreams when she invites him to a huge end-of-summer party.

title: Animal Factory
description: Sentenced to the state penitentiary for dealing drugs, a middle-class young man (Edward Furlong) seeks protection from a savvy inmate (Willem Dafoe).

title: Sin City: A Dame to Kill For
description: In the central story, Dwight McCarthy (Josh Brolin) struggles with his inner demons and tries to maintain control until his former lover, Ava Lord (Eva Green), returns wanting his help to escape her abusive husband.

title: Assault on Precinct 13
description: Cops and convicts join forces to defend a barren police station from a vengeance-seeking street gang.

title: Then Came You
description: A terminally ill teenager and a 19-year-old hypochondriac help each other achieve their dreams and face their fears.

title: Poolhall Junkies
description: A billiards player ends his conflicted friendship with a con man who taught him how to play the game.

title: The Long Good Friday
description: A Cockney crime czar (Bob Hoskins) and his mistress (Helen Mirren) answer a threat on the eve of his big deal with a U.S. mobster (Eddie Constantine).

title: Bullet in the Head
description: Three Hong Kong gang fighters (Tony Leung Chiu Wai, Jacky Cheung, Waise Lee) try crime in Vietnam and land in a prison camp with U.S. soldiers.

title: The Lady Vanishes
description: An heiress (Cybill Shepherd) and a photographer (Elliott Gould) are sure an English nanny (Angela Lansbury) was on their train in the Alps.

title: Bright Young Things
description: After losing the manuscript of his first novel, a penniless writer (Stephen Campbell Moore) must raise enough money to marry his superficial girlfriend (Emily Mortimer).

title: Piranha
description: A government tank containing genetically engineered piranha is unwittingly emptied into a river that flows past a resort area.

title: Buena Vista Social Club
description: Filmmaker Wim Wenders shows a number of renowned Cuban musicians of all ages who gathered to create a Grammy-winning album.

title: Winter Kills
description: The brother (Jeff Bridges) of an assassinated U.S. president reopens the case on a rumor of conspiracy.

title: Bad Moon
description: A photojournalist (Michael Paré) feels the beast growing within him after being bitten by one during an expedition.

title: Battle Beyond the Stars
description: Shad of Akir (Richard Thomas) recruits a space cowboy (George Peppard) and other warriors to defend his planet from a barbarian's army.

title: Season of the Witch
description: Knights (Nicolas Cage, Ron Perlman) escort an accused witch to a remote abbey, where monks will perform a ritual in the hope of ending the pestilence ravaging Europe.

title: Sleepaway Camp
description: Bunks and the showers are a mad stabber's beat at a summer camp strictly for teens.

title: C.H.U.D.
description: Lovers (John Heard, Kim Greist) and other New Yorkers face cannibalistic humanoid underground dwellers, spawned by toxic waste.

title: City of Industry
description: A retired thief (Harvey Keitel) joins his brother and two accomplices in Los Angeles for a final heist.

title: Derailed
description: An undercover operative (Jean-Claude Van Damme) battles terrorists after they seize a train containing biological weapons.

title: The Killer Meteors
description: A powerful man seeks help from a local hero (Jackie Chan) whose secret weapon makes him invincible.

title: Point Break
description: An FBI agent (Keanu Reeves) turns California surfer to nab bank robbers who wear rubber masks of four ex-presidents.

title: Crime Story
description: A Hong Kong detective (Jackie Chan) teams with a police veteran (Kent Cheng) to rescue a wealthy businessman from kidnappers.

title: Communion
description: A novelist's (Christopher Walken) wife (Lindsay Crouse) and son (Joel Carlson) see him changed by an apparent encounter with aliens in the mountains.

title: Charade
description: A suave stranger (Cary Grant) helps a chic widow (Audrey Hepburn) stalked by four men looking for loot in Paris.

title: The Slumber Party Massacre
description: Someone with a power drill shows up uninvited to Trish's (Michele Michaels) high-school pajama party.

title: Bloodfist III: Forced to Fight
description: An innocent half-Asian kickboxer is caught between two other races at war in prison.

title: Candy
description: A fatherly chemistry professor indulges two young lovers in their ever-increasing heroin habits as his life spins out of control.

title: Clockwatchers
description: Friendship helps make nightmarish office jobs bearable for four young women working as temporary employees.

title: The Killing Time
description: A stranger's (Kiefer Sutherland) arrival changes a California sheriff's (Beau Bridges) plan to kill his lover's husband (Wayne Rogers).

title: Prison on Fire 2
description: Ching escapes from prison to see his young son who has been put in an orphanage.

title: Snake and Crane Arts of Shaolin
description: Hsu Yiu Fong (Jackie Chan) guards a powerful book against numerous clans after the eight Shaolin masters who wrote it go missing.

title: The Brood
description: A mad doctor tries psychoplasmic therapy on a raging woman soon to be a mother.

title: Sisters
description: A small-time reporter tries to convince the police she saw a murder in the apartment across from hers.

title: A Walk to Remember
description: Forced to tutor students at a school, a young delinquent (Shane West) falls for a minister's (Peter Coyote) daughter (Mandy Moore).

title: Don't Tell Mom the Babysitter's Dead
description: 17-year-old Tanya and her three siblings are left in the charge of a crotchety old babysitter who suddenly dies. Posing as an adult, Tanya gets an assistant gig at a fashion company and is thrust into the world of adulthood and parenting.

title: The TV Set
description: A network picks up Mike Klein's (David Duchovny) pilot for a TV series, and now he must navigate through one incompetent executive after another, hoping the concept of the show still bears some resemblance to his original idea.

title: Elegy
description: A beautiful student (Penélope Cruz) throws into disarray the life of an aging lecturer and cultural critic (Ben Kingsley) when she awakens in him feelings of sexual possessiveness.

title: Breakfast of Champions
description: An unhappy car dealer (Bruce Willis) believes that a dime-store author/philosopher (Albert Finney) has the answers to life's important questions.

title: Jiminy Glick in Lalawood
description: A celebrity interviewer (Martin Short) and his wife (Jan Hooks) become tangled in a murder mystery involving a boozy actress, her family and her publicist.

title: Fong Sai-Yuk II
description: A man (Jet Li) dominated by his martial-artist mother (Josephine Hsiao) joins an anti-Manchu society led by a mysterious godfather (Adam Cheng).

title: Gunfight at Rio Bravo
description: A mysterious Russian gunslinger aids a marshal and a sheriff in a standoff with an outlaw gang who have invaded their town.

title: Cobra Verde
description: A Brazilian plantation owner sends an employee (Klaus Kinski) to West Africa to re-establish a slave network.
